What we do

Five service families. One coordinated team.

A website alone cannot fix slow follow-up. Software creates little value if it does not connect to the rest of the business, or if the team does not know how to use it. We work across all five, so the work is sequenced as one programme.

01

Websites & digital platforms

Websites and web experiences built to make it easier for your customers to enquire, book, buy and engage.

We design, build, redesign and manage websites and web platforms around a clear business outcome, then keep improving them.

Typical deliverables:

  • Business websites and redesigns
  • E-commerce and product journeys
  • Landing pages and campaign pages
  • Customer portals and web apps
  • Performance, usability and accessibility improvements
  • Ongoing maintenance of the sites we manage

Who benefits: Businesses with an outdated website, a weak enquiry path, a poor mobile experience or a need for a more useful customer platform.

Not included: Domain disputes, content we have not agreed to write, and websites outside your agreed plan.

Discuss this service →

02

Software & business systems

Custom tools, portals and dashboards designed around how your business actually operates.

When off-the-shelf software does not fit, we build operational software that does, and look after it after launch.

Typical deliverables:

  • Custom operational software
  • CRMs and client systems
  • Internal dashboards and reporting
  • Client and staff portals
  • Business platforms built on your data

Who benefits: Teams running important work on spreadsheets, inboxes or tools that no longer fit the way they operate.

Not included: Licences for third-party software we do not build, and systems outside your agreed scope.

Discuss this service →

03

Business automation & AI

Replace repetitive work with reliable workflows and carefully scoped AI-powered solutions.

We find the tasks that take time every week and design automations and AI-assisted workflows around the way your team already works.

Typical deliverables:

  • Repeatable workflow automation
  • AI assistants for defined business tasks
  • Follow-ups and customer notifications
  • Scheduled reports
  • Content workflows
  • AI-enabled business processes

Who benefits: Teams spending too much time copying information, chasing follow-ups, preparing repetitive reports or coordinating routine work by hand.

Not included: Open-ended AI experiments without a defined task, and AI or automation usage beyond your plan’s allowance unless you approve it.

Discuss this service →

04

Systems integration

Connect the tools you already use so data moves where it should.

Disconnected tools create duplicate work, missed context and slow responses. We connect the systems behind your customer journey and operations.

Typical deliverables:

  • Website and form connections
  • Payment, booking and calendar integrations
  • CRM and email integrations
  • WhatsApp connections, where appropriate
  • Inventory and external API integrations

Who benefits: Businesses whose website, inbox, CRM, spreadsheets, calendar and customer conversations do not work as one process.

Not included: Systems we have not agreed to connect, and responsibility for third-party platforms’ own outages.

Discuss this service →

05

Technology consulting & training

Make informed technology decisions, and equip your people to use what we build.

We help leaders decide what to build or improve next, and train the people who will use the systems.

Typical deliverables:

  • Digital systems reviews
  • Technology roadmaps
  • AI adoption coaching
  • Training on AI tools
  • Training on the software and systems we build
  • Documentation for delivered work

Who benefits: Teams adopting new tools, and leaders deciding where technology investment should go next.

Not included: General IT helpdesk, device repair and office network support.

Discuss this service →

Ongoing responsibility

More than one-off development.

We can maintain what we build, improve the systems you already rely on, and work alongside your team month after month.

A typical partnership might start with a clearer website and enquiry flow, then connect enquiries to a CRM, automate the follow-up, add a dashboard and train the team. One roadmap, sequenced sensibly, instead of unrelated tasks from several providers.

The boundary

Said plainly, so nobody is surprised later.

Clear about what we do.

DakyXTech is a remote-first technology partner. We work through email, scheduled meetings, calls and screen sharing, and every request is tracked.

We do not repair laptops or printers, install office networks, provide physical-device support, run managed cybersecurity operations, administer everyday business email or cloud infrastructure, or offer general on-site IT support.

Where a specialist service is required, we will say so clearly.
